slides.heading: Array Of Products
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Arrays
slides.narration: Let's solve Array Of Products, a medium arrays problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Out[i] = product of every element except a[i], without division.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Out i equals product of every element except a i , without division. Prefix products then suffix products.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Each output is the product of everything to the left times everything to the right, so two sweeps replace division.
slides.narration: Each output is the product of everything to the left times everything to the right, so two sweeps replace division.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Fill each slot with the running product from the left
2. Sweep from the right with a second running product
slides.narration: Step by step. First, fill each slot with the running product from the left. Second, sweep from the right with a second running product. Third, multiply it in. Fourth, no division needed.

slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is O of n output.

slides.heading: Recap
